title: Sleep Private KP front
bodyHtml: Sleep is a complex trait that is essential for performance, well-being, and health. While genetic studies have been conducted on sleep and circadian traits, a comprehensive analysis of clinically diagnosed sleep disorders and sleep medications has not been performed. This study aims to identify novel genetic variants associated with sleep disorders and medications used to treat sleep-related disorders. This private portal visualizes the genetic results from a meta-analysis of sleep disorders and related medications across the UK Biobank, FINNGEN, and Mass General Brigham Biobank cohorts.
